name: NURBS Spline Representation for Measurement Coordinates
aliases: NURBS spline representation for measurement coordinates
NURBS surface optimization for measurement coordinates
Rational B-spline optimization for view angles
definition: Represents uncertain measurement coordinates (view angles, tilt angles, detector locations) as a NURBS surface whose control points and weights are optimized alongside the volume reconstruction.
summary: NURBS Spline Representation for Measurement Coordinates models uncertain measurement data using optimized control points to explicitly enforce physical consistency, unlike implicit neural representations.
